'''Doctor Metzar''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed aboard the Republic [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|''Gav Daragon'']], he sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].<ref name="TOR" />
